ma.onSocketMessage(function callback)

Listen for events that messages are received through the WebSocket connection from the server.

Parameter

function callback

Callback function used when messages are received through the WebSocket connection from the server.

Parameter

Object res
Attribute Type Description
data String Message returned by the server.

Sample Code

ma.connectSocket({
  url: 'wss://example.com'
});
ma.onSocketMessage((res) => {
  console.log(res.data);
});
